description:
Welcome to Nashville! I would be happy to host you. Whether you're a music enthusiast exploring the renowned music scene or a sports fan catching a game, this house promises a delightful and centrally located retreat for an unforgettable stay in Nashville.

The space
Accommodation Details:
~ The townhouse features 2 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. Both bedrooms and full bathrooms are located on the 2nd floor. There is a half bathroom located on the 1st floor. 
~ Each bedroom is equipped with a queen-sized bed, and there's an additional queen-sized sleeper sofa in the living room.

Kitchen Amenities:
~Fully outfitted kitchen with a stove, oven, microwave, regular coffee pot, and toaster.
~ Some coffee ground and filters are provided. 
~Please note: Pantry items are not provided

Laundry Facilities:
~Washer and dryer are available in the condo for your convenience.
~ Some laundry detergent pods are provided.

Guest access
Guests will access to the entire home. I do my best to provide you with all the essentials for your stay. If there is a special request for your trip, please reach out ahead of time so that I might be of better assistance for your stay!

Other things to note
Property Location and Accessibility:
~ Conveniently situated less than 4 miles from Downtown Lower Broadway.
~ Just 7 miles away from Nashville International Airport (BNA).

Parking:
~Each unit includes two free parking spaces.

Provided Essentials:
~Linens, towels, shampoo, conditioner, and soaps are provided.
~Essentials such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, and dish pods are supplied for your stay.
~Please be aware that these items are not replenished during longer stays.
